title: keygen and key_rotate duplicate PKCS#8/SPKI DER header bytes
description: transit/cli/keygen.rs and key_rotate.rs both hard-code identical PKCS#8 and SPKI DER header byte sequences. Extract to a shared constant in core or a keysupport submodule. A future change to key encoding must be applied in both places or creates silently incompatible key files.
